title: Prove sharp per-addition Newton bulk precision and high-degree cost
body:
The high-degree Newton bulk now has an exact per-addition precision law for the literal PR5825 falling-factor graph under independent residue-lift errors. This answers PR5900's second open question in that stated error model and removes the earlier uniform-precision premise.

```text
D_h = max(h <= k <= R) [k - 2h + 2 + 2 v_2(h binom(k,h))]
q_h = max(0, p + D_h)
minimum neighbor-ADD precision mass = n 2^n sum_h q_h
```

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/12c38d11e819b20fa11245be810baecbfdff1fe1/research/newton-backward-precision/PROOF.md) gives simultaneous sufficiency and an explicit failing coordinate if any positive q_h is reduced by one. The largest maximizing k prevents cancellation of the leading digit. For n=p=8,R=7 the exact demands are (16,15,14,13,8,7,3), with mass 155648. For p>=R-1, the mass is at least n*2^n*R*(p+1). Changing the interval cannot lower this optimum.

This is a sharp scoped cost result, not a new kappa or a general Gaussian lower bound. Errors may be arbitrary independent multiples of pi^q after each neighbor ADD; all other operations are exact. **The proof does not assert that deterministic rounding on a restricted reachable lattice generates every such error.** Changed graphs, dependent errors and shared bulk/residual computation remain possible directions.

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.13 replay agrees on 1,323 exact kernel stages, 70 literal perturbed columns, all 48 internal additions of a signed fixture, 196 one-digit failure witnesses, 20 simultaneous-error words, eight invalid plans and three retained source pins. The forward interpreter and integer pi-division oracle are separate from the closed formula. Metadata, committed bytes/modes, official export and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay pass. [Validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/12c38d11e819b20fa11245be810baecbfdff1fe1/research/newton-backward-precision/VALIDATION.md) records limits. Full-history preflight is unrun in this shallow checkout; exact predecessor bytes are retained, so clean replay needs no side-branch object. Hosted plan and package replay [pass](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41553891369) at the verified head.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/newton-backward-precision
```

Only `research/newton-backward-precision/` is added. Native realization, physical routing, erasure, complete binary-time and caller bills, independent scientific acceptance and all five selected assumptions remain open. The selected frontier is unchanged.

[Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19363141). Canonical base `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority8/selected6030, refreshed unchanged before submission. Related work: PR5900 is the low-degree residual-prefix result and explicit high-degree question; PR5890 is the endpoint bulk-denominator result. These are credited rather than re-audited. Latest claims and open PRs were checked with sparse/unpublished coverage limits.

Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Classical Boolean expansion, Vandermonde and valuation theory retain credit. No merge or closure is requested.
